assumptions: the holder fields at +0x00/+0x08/+0x10 are a buffer begin, a qword slot count and a list head; the routine reads begin and count for the buffer phase and the head for the list phase

a buffer begin equal to the holder+0x30 address is the holder's own inline storage, because the routine compares exactly those two values and returns plainly on equality instead of freeing; the contents of the inline storage are not otherwise read

buffer_phase.always_runs: the buffer phase runs even when the list head is null
buffer_phase.clear: memset(begin, 0, count * 8) via the memset PLT at 0x63f0a90, with count reloaded from holder+0x08 and begin reloaded from holder+0x00 after the list phase
buffer_phase.fields_zeroed: holder+0x10 (the list head) and holder+0x18 are zeroed; the role of +0x18 beyond being zeroed is not claimed
buffer_phase.free: unless begin equals holder+0x30, a tail jump to the sized-delete PLT at 0x63f0d80 frees (begin, count * 8); a null begin with count 0 still reaches this tail jump with size 0
buffer_phase.inline_rule: begin equal to holder+0x30 returns plainly after the zeroing, with no buffer free
buffer_phase.unread_fields: holder bytes at +0x20..+0x30 are never read; their roles are not claimed

consumers.argument_setup_pattern: at 0x5d821de rdi is loaded from the stack slot -0x878(%rbp) immediately before the call; at 0x5d825c3 rdi is lea -0x7c0(%rbp), the same address stored to -0x878(%rbp) immediately before the call

list_phase.delete: each node is freed with a sized delete of exactly 0x10 bytes via the sized-delete PLT at 0x63f0d80
list_phase.next_pointer: the next pointer at node +0x00 is loaded before the node is freed
list_phase.node_payload: no node field other than +0x00 is read; node payload roles are not claimed
list_phase.null_head: a null head skips the phase and the buffer phase still runs
list_phase.order: nodes are freed in list order, head first
list_phase.start: the head is holder+0x10, read once at entry

arguments.rdi: holder pointer: buffer begin +0x00, slot count +0x08, list head +0x10

routine.prologue: endbr64, pushes rbp and rbx, 8 bytes stack reserve, no canary check
routine.result: no return value; the routine frees the holder's node list, zeroes and conditionally frees its buffer, and zeroes holder+0x10/+0x18

unknowns: the role of holder+0x18 beyond being zeroed in the buffer phase
the identities of the two caller functions beyond their FDE ranges
behavior when the buffer begin is null while the count is nonzero (the zeroing would run through a null base; no such call is observed)
